title: RNAseq Analysis of Gastric Vagal Afferent Neurons
author: Martin Stebbing
materials: Samples are further digested with 2 mg/mL collagenase type I and 0.075% Trypsin-EDTA (Sigma, Cat n o T4049) in L-15 medium at 37 o C with orbital shaking (120 rpm) for 45 minutes. Collagenase Type 1 Worthington Biochemical Corporation Catalog #LS004197 (CAS: 9001-12-1) Trypsin-EDTA solution Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #T4049

Nodose ganglia are immediately dissected out and placed in ice-cold Leibovitz’s L-15 medium (Gibco/Thermo Fisher, Cat n o 21083-027). Connective tissue around the ganglia is removed, and a longitudinal slit is made in the capsule with a scalpel blade. Leibovitz's L-15 Medium, no phenol red Thermo Fisher Catalog #21083027

Samples are next spun down at 1000 x g for 5 min at 4oC and washed in L-15 medium containing 100 μunits/mL DNAase type I (Sigma, Cat no D-4527). Deoxyribonuclease I from bovine pancreas Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #D4527

Samples are again spun down at 1000 x g for 5 min at 4 o C. Ganglia are washed for the second time in L-15 medium containing 100 μunits/mL DNAase type I Deoxyribonuclease I from bovine pancreas Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #D4527
and analyzing them using a 2200 Tapestation system. cDNA concentration is determined using Qubit dsDNA HS Assay kits (Invitrogen, Cat n o : Q

cDNA is purified using a magnetic bead kit (Nucleomag NGS clean-up and Size Select, Macherey-Nagel GmbH & Co., Cat n o 744970.5) according to the manufacturer instructions. cDNA quality is assessed by loading purified cDNA into High sensitivity D5000 screen tapes (Agilent Technologies, Cat n o 5067-5592) and analyzing them using a 2200 Tapestation system. cDNA concentration is determined using Qubit dsDNA HS Assay kits (Invitrogen, Cat n o : Q32851) according to manufacturer instructions. Nucleomag NGS clean-up and Size Select Takara Bio Inc. Catalog #744970.5 High Sensitivity D5000 ScreenTape Agilent Technologies Catalog #5067-5592

steps.title: Euthanize Rats and Harvest Tissues
steps.instruction: Euthanize Sprague Dawley rats (RRID: RGD_10395233) that received fluorescent bead injections 7-14 days prior using an overdose of Pentobarbital (100 mg/kg i.p.).

substeps.instruction: Dissect out the stomach, open it flat, and fix in 4% PFA in PBS overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Digest Nodose Ganglia
steps.instruction: Digest left (LNG) and/or right (RNG) nodose ganglia separately using 2 mg/mL collagenase type I (Worthington, Cat no LS004196/7) in L-15 medium.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 37 °C with orbital shaking (120 rpm) for 45 minutes.
Spin down samples at 1000 x g for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Homogeneous Cell Suspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend nodose ganglion samples in L-15 medium containing 100 μunits/mL DNAase type I.

substeps.instruction: Triturate using flame-polished glass Pasteur’s pipettes coated with 1% bovine serum albumin, passing ganglia up and down the stem with decreasing inner diameters until homogeneous.
Spin down the cell suspension at 1000 x g for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Settle Cells for Picking
steps.instruction: Resuspend dissociated nodose ganglia cells in L-15 medium (without enzymes) and place them on coverslip bottom 35 mm culture dishes (Fluorodish, WPI).

substeps.instruction: Allow cells to settle for 20 minutes before manual cell picking.

steps.title: Identify and Sample Labeled Neurons
steps.instruction: Use an inverted fluorescence microscope with red and green filters to identify labeled neurons by bright, small red fluorescent cytoplasmic puncta.

substeps.instruction: Clear debris and other cells around the target cell using a small diameter 'sweeping' pipette attached to a micromanipulator.
Record the cell position using the microscope stage vernier scale.
Introduce a 45-degree beveled sampling pipette into the bath (bevel parallel to dish surface) using a micromanipulator.
Apply slight positive pressure to pull a single cell (or up to 12 labeled cells for pooled samples) into the pipette.
For unlabeled control cells, collect in the same manner but without clearing surrounding cells.

steps.title: Collect and Freeze Cells
steps.instruction: Expel collected cells from the pipette using slight positive pressure into an RNAse-free microfuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Break the pipette tip within the tube to ensure all adherent cells are collected.
Perform a brief spin to aggregate the sample.
Estimate the volume of solution collected.
Snap freeze the sample on dry ice and store at -80 °C.

steps.title: Perform mRNA Amplification and cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Perform mRNA amplification and cDNA synthesis using SMART-Seq HT kits (Takara Bio USA, Inc., Cat no 634456) according to manufacturer instructions.

substeps.instruction: Add lysis buffer containing RNAase inhibitors while cells are still frozen.

Set up one-step PCR reactions (SMARTscribe reverse transcriptase and SeqAmp DNA polymerase) with the following thermal profile: 1) 42 °C for 90 min; 2) 95 °C for 1 min; 3) 98 °C for 10 sec; 4) 65 °C for 30 sec; 5) 68 °C for 3 min; 6) 72 °C for 10 min.
For steps 3-5, perform 14 cycles for pooled cell samples or 16 cycles for single cell samples.

steps.title: Prepare DNA Libraries
steps.instruction: Quantify amplified cDNA using Qubit and use 600 pg of cDNA for library preparation using the Illumina Nextera XT DNA Library Kit (Ref Guide 15031942, Cat #FC-131-1096).

substeps.instruction: QC libraries using Qubit and Bioanalyzer (expected mean size ~360 bp at 15 ng/uL).
Quantify libraries by qPCR and use size-adjusted concentration for sequencing.

steps.title: Sequence Libraries
steps.instruction: Prepare library pools combining 12 to 150 barcoded samples (control and labeled) per run, including 1% PhiX control.

substeps.instruction: Use denatured libraries at 2.0 pM (NSQ 550) or non-denatured libraries at 1000 pM (NSQ 2k).
Perform onboard clustering for high output runs (NextSeq v2.5 75bp on NSQ550 or v3.0 100 bp on NSQ2k P3).
Target 30-40 million reads per pooled sample or 5-10 million reads per single cell sample.

steps.title: Analyze Sequencing Data
steps.instruction: Map raw fragment sequencing data (fastq files) to the rat genome assembly (mRatBN7.2, Feb 2021, Sanger Institute) using HISAT2.

substeps.instruction: Determine the number of reads mapped to each gene using Featurecounts.
Generate a single count matrix and determine differential gene expression (DEG) using the Edge R method on the Galaxy platform.
Normalize counts by the trimmed mean of M (log2 fold change) values.
Filter out low count expression genes using a threshold of 1 count per million reads for the whole genome assembly (no filter for smaller subsets like GPCRs or ion channels).
